title: A pragmatic builder
paragraphs: Software Engineering student at Concordia, interning at Ericsson. I ship AI systems end-to-end: data pipelines, fine-tuning, APIs, and the UI that ties it all together.

I like problems where the legacy is messier than the spec. Reverse-engineering an undocumented VCS. Replacing brittle Selenium scrapers with direct API calls. Reimplementing LoRA from scratch because I wanted to check the paper's numbers myself.
